scope: Small synthetic release comparison; not representative of all agent work or an overall superiority claim
arms: AgentForge reviewed plan and isolated execution
Direct same-model plan and identical isolated executor
order: Alternate arms within each task/trial; task order as listed
fairness: Identical task prompt, input bytes, model and generation settings
Identical execution environment and tool availability
No expected-output files or evaluator code visible to either model
Human review only accepts or rejects; no edits or hints
No replacement of failed or timed-out attempts
No tuning these cases after seeing outputs; changes require a new version and separate report

scoring.pass: Exact parsed JSON deep equality plus unchanged input hash
scoring.failure: Mismatch, timeout, invalid output, unsafe plan rejection, provider error or missing artifact
report: Reported input/output tokens; unknown values remain unknown
Cost only when sourced; never assume zero
Paired outcomes and uncertainty; no claim from an isolated success
